## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Extended Record of Chán Master Xiātáng Huìyuǎn* — a four-juan Southern-Sòng *yǔlù* of **Xiātáng Huìyuǎn** 瞎堂慧遠 (1103–1176), Línjì-Yángqí Hǔ-qiū-line master; dharma-heir of Yuánwù Kèqín. Compiled by four *cānxué* disciples: [Qíjǐ](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%BD%8A%E5%B7%B1), [Rúběn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%82%E6%9C%AC), [Zǔchún](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%96%E6%B7%B3), [Fǎhuì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%85%A7).

Four-juan Southern-Sòng Chán *guǎng lù*, X69 n1360.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1150; *notAfter* c. 1180.
